notes.subject: Toogoda
notes.rationale: Verse opens with a bare imperative summoning the hearer to remember.

notes.subject: i / aw
notes.rationale: Direct address to Israel as a single 'you' shifting to plural 'aw' at the going-out from Egypt.

notes.subject: waati la
notes.rationale: Bambara needs a time expression ('when') for בצאתכם, supplied with ⟨…⟩-class connector.

notes.subject: זכור / זכר
notes.rationale: Verse 17's zakhor (remember) is answered by verse 19's zekher (memory) — frame lost if the two roots diverge in the target.

translation: Toogoda min kɛra i la: Amalek (Amaleku) ye ⟨את⟩ o kɛ i la sira la, aw bɛ Misira (Ejipiti) bɔ waati la.
